privileged_info_for_vlm: On 1919-05-29 at 14:15 UTC, a total solar eclipse occurred. From Príncipe (1.66 N, 7.40 E), the Sun was located in the constellation Taurus. Prominent stars/clusters near the Sun during this event included Aldebaran and the Hyades cluster. In Stellarium, the atmosphere (shortcut 'A') and ground (shortcut 'G') must be toggled off to see stars clearly during the day, and constellation lines ('C') and labels ('V') must be toggled on.
